verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item addresses telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out settings or privacy controls for QuickBooks Online; all docs focus on accounting features, integrations, and MCP/API tooling. This is a fair axis to ask of a SaaS product handling sensitive financial data, but absence of evidence means it cannot be credited. Missing for 10: any privacy policy documentation, telemetry opt-out settings, or usage-tracking disclosure.
